title: New tab
desc: Open a new tab with the address bar ready

title: Close tab
desc: Close the current tab. Pinned tabs stay open

title: Reopen closed tab
desc: Bring back the tab closed last, with its history

title: Duplicate tab
desc: Open a copy of the current tab

title: Next tab
desc: Select the tab below the current one

title: Previous tab
desc: Select the tab above the current one

title: First tab
desc: Select the first tab of the list

title: Last tab
desc: Select the last tab of the list

title: Previously used tab
desc: Go back to the tab you were on before this one

title: Move tab up
desc: Move the current tab one place up the list

title: Move tab down
desc: Move the current tab one place down the list

title: Pin or unpin tab
desc: Pinned tabs stay at the top, cannot be closed by accident and are never suspended

title: Mute or unmute tab
desc: Silence the current tab, or let it sound again. Playback continues

title: Move tab to another workspace
desc: Choose a workspace and reopen the current page there

title: Focus the tab list
desc: Move the keyboard to the tab list: j and k move, Enter selects, Escape returns to the page

title: Focus the page
desc: Give the keyboard back to the page

title: Address bar
desc: Type an address, a search, an alias such as yt, a bang such as !w, or a calculation

title: Back
desc: Go to the previous page of this tab

title: Forward
desc: Go to the next page of this tab

title: Up one level of the address
desc: Remove the last part of the address: example.com/a/b becomes example.com/a

title: Top of the site
desc: Open the first page of the current site

title: Reload
desc: Load the current page again

title: Reload without cache
desc: Load the current page again and fetch every file anew

title: Stop loading
desc: Stop loading the current page

title: Link hints
desc: Put a letter label on every link, button and field on screen; type a label to activate it

title: Link hints: open in a background tab
desc: Like link hints, but the link you choose opens in a background tab

title: Focus the first text field
desc: Put the caret in the first text field on screen

title: Find in page
desc: Search for text in the current page

title: Find next
desc: Go to the next match of the last search in this page

title: Find previous
desc: Go to the previous match of the last search in this page

title: Copy page address
desc: Copy the address of the current page to the clipboard

title: Zoom in
desc: Make the current site larger

title: Zoom out
desc: Make the current site smaller

title: Reset zoom
desc: Return the current site to 100%

title: Reader view
desc: Show only the article of the current page, in a clean layout

title: Print
desc: Print the current page or save it as a PDF

title: Full screen
desc: Give the whole screen to the page. Run it again to leave

title: Workspaces and tabs
desc: List every workspace and its tabs; switch, rename, reorder, or move tabs between them

title: Next workspace
desc: Go to the window of the next workspace, opening it if needed

title: Previous workspace
desc: Go to the window of the previous workspace, opening it if needed

title: New workspace
desc: Create a workspace with its own cookies, logins and extensions

title: Private window
desc: Open a private window, which keeps no history or cookies. From a private window, close them all

title: Split view: side by side
desc: Show the current tab and the next one side by side. Run it again to close the split

title: Split view: stacked
desc: Show the current tab above the next one. Run it again to close the split

title: Split view: change orientation
desc: Switch the split between side by side and stacked

title: Split view: focus the other pane
desc: Move the keyboard to the other page of the split

title: Split view: swap panes
desc: Exchange the two pages of the split

title: Split view: close
desc: Go back to one page. Both tabs stay open

title: History
desc: Search the pages you visited in every workspace, or clear them

title: Bookmarks
desc: Open, search, edit and reorder your saved pages

title: Bookmark this page
desc: Save the current page to your bookmarks

title: Downloads
desc: Show the download shelf, or the list of downloads when it is empty

title: Developer tools
desc: Open or close Chromium's developer tools for the current page

title: Play or pause media in every tab
desc: Pause whatever is playing in any tab, or resume what this paused

title: Mute or unmute every tab
desc: Silence every tab of every workspace, or let them sound again

title: Suspend background tabs
desc: Pause the background pages that are doing nothing. They stay in memory and resume where they were

title: Resume suspended tabs
desc: Resume the suspended pages of this workspace

title: Extension actions
desc: List the actions, commands and options of the extensions of this workspace

title: Open the user scripts folder
desc: Open the folder whose .user.js files Fly runs in matching pages

title: Open the user styles folder
desc: Open the folder whose .user.css files Fly applies to matching pages

title: Reload user scripts and styles
desc: Read the user scripts and styles folders again

title: Preferences
desc: Search, appearance, keyboard, privacy, extensions and performance settings

title: Keyboard settings
desc: See every shortcut and page key, and change them

title: Pin or unpin the sidebar
desc: Keep the sidebar open, or let it shrink to a strip of icons that opens under the pointer

title: Show or hide the status bar
desc: Show or hide the bar at the bottom of the window

title: Show or hide the clock
desc: Show or hide the clock in the status bar

title: Change the clock format
desc: Date and time, time only, or time with seconds

title: Show or hide the window buttons
desc: Show or hide the minimise, maximise and close buttons at the top of the sidebar

title: Switch between dark and light
desc: Switch the interface between the dark and the light theme

title: Turn web notifications on or off
desc: Allow or silence the notifications of every site

title: Fly menu
desc: Open Fly's menu

title: Check for updates
desc: Ask GitHub whether a newer Fly has been released

title: What's New
desc: Open the list of changes of the releases you have installed

title: Diagnostics
desc: Versions, processes, memory and the local event log, with a report to copy into an issue

title: Turn diagnostics recording on or off
desc: Start or stop keeping page errors and warnings in memory. Nothing leaves this computer

title: Open Google sign-in in a private window
desc: Check that Google accepts a sign-in from Fly without touching your workspaces
